runtime_cleanup.cleanup_method: Stopped the two QA test servers and explicitly removed their disposable DB; user services left running.

blocking_or_review_items: Agent mock map differs from the candidate; compatibility check exits1
Natural-language Exit9-1 resolves to Exit1/9 with FakeLLM; real model untested
Synthetic localization L24 regresses: wrong-station text matches Line1 platform
Refund route between free-area nodes enters and leaves a paid gate; free-only graph is disconnected for that pair
Ticket-purchase wording is shown on a Line4 transfer route
Frozen R3 POI exact-set score and version metadata require scope review
UI exposes raw category labels; panorama render completion remains unverified

environment.note: jsonschema was added only to the ignored QA virtualenv for Data CI read-only checks. No dependency manifests changed.

limitations: Actual model/embedding calls0; no production DB, deployment, phone camera/sensors or field photo verification
OSM snapshot, estimated geometry, paid/free areas, wheelchair access and two-way links are not field-certified by graph reachability
Already running user servers/DB were not used for destructive tests; all new DBs were created and removed by QA
No uncommitted Data source files/map snapshots are included in published QA evidence; only metadata, hashes and reviewed test observations
Complete main baseline is preserved. Dirty candidate is supplemental evidence and must not be promoted by HEAD SHA alone
